entities.short_description: Raditz is the main antagonist of the Raditz Saga, and the first antagonist in Dragon Ball Z.

entities.name: Rampaging
entities.description:
The artificial hybrid Demon Earthling Mira is part Saiyan, and thus through the power of anger is capable of undergoing the Rampaging form prior to taking on his own Super Saiyan form.

After fusing with a Dark Dragon Ball and then eating a Fruit of the Tree of Might, Xeno Turles transformed into the Rampaging form. This version of the form is the result of the power of the Fruit of the Tree of Might merging with the dark power gained from the Dark Dragon Ball, causing the dark streaks stemming from the Dark Dragon Ball-embedded area to further stretch across his body and over face.

Kale's Legendary Super Saiyan form is a "Rampaging" state.

During the Universal Conflict Saga, Fu uses the Big Gete Star to convert Cooler into Meta-Cooler, and he achieves his own Rampaging form, as evidenced by his black left sclera and mechanical lines running up and down the left side of his face. His Rampaging form could also be coupled with Golden Meta-Cooler. Meta-Cooler stopped using the form before the beginning of the Universe Creation Saga in the anime.

entities.short_description: The artificial hybrid Demon Earthling Mira is part Saiyan, and thus through the power of anger is capable of undergoing the Rampaging form prior to taking on his own Super Saiyan form.

entities.name: Rappa
entities.description:
Rappa has Nappa's facial features and facial hair, but with Raditz's long spiky hair and black and brown Battle Armor. Unlike his Fusion Dance counterpart, Rappa lacks a Scouter and wears a Metamo-Ring on his left forearm. He also possesses a Saiyan Tail which he wraps around his waist just like both his fusee do.

Like his fusees, Rappa is a proud and brutish Saiyan warrior. He seems happy about his increased power gained as a result of being a fusion.

As EX-Fusions is weaker than fusions produced by the Metamoran Fusion Dance, presumably Rappa is weaker than his Fusion Dance counterpart, Natz. However, Rappa has the advantage of not being bound by a time limit as he can remain fused as long as he continues to wear his Metamo-Ring, while Natz can only maintain his fusion for half an hour, thus while he may be weaker in terms of power, he can remain fused much longer than Natz.

Like Natz, Rappa is a B-Rank fighter which makes his EX-Fusion weaker than the likes of EX Gotenks, EX Yamhan, Bulpan, Pandel, Dodobon, and Turtz who are all A-Rank.

entities.name: Renso
entities.description:
Renso has black hair with a widow's peak, which he wears in a ponytail. He has a chinbeard and wears Japanese style clothing with the exception of his buckled belt. He also wears a dark blue tunic with a dark blue hakama and sandals. Over his tunic, he has a long brown jacket.

Renso is a humble Saiyan warrior who knows of his limitations, a trait shown when he refuses to participate in the Tournament of Power due to his injury. He is also proud of the pupils he trained and amazed at Cabba's ability to turn into a Super Saiyan, awed at the form's immense strength that Cabba can use for good.

Renso is visited by Cabba and was asked to join Team Universe 6 to compete in the Tournament of Power. Renso, however, declines knowing he is not as strong as he used to be, and due to his injured leg. He then suggests Cabba to go ask his younger sister, Caulifla, to join the team as her potential and power is higher than his.

When Team Universe 6 lost in the Tournament of Power, Renso was erased with the rest of Universe 6. He is later revived when the erased universes were restored by Super Shenron due to Android 17's wish at the end of the Tournament.

entities.name: S-Cells
entities.description:
S-Cells dwell within a Saiyan's body and vary in amount depending on the composure of their spirit. By raising their battle power, a Saiyan can increase the number of S-Cells within their body.

A Saiyan with a gentler nature will have more initial S-Cells compared to a Saiyan with a violent nature. This is most apparent when comparing Universe 7 Saiyans to Universe 6 Saiyans. The former Universe contained a violent Saiyan society that valued aggression and ruthlessness after the wipeout of the good Saiyans, while the latter did not give into those tendencies and retained a heroic nature. As such, the lives of Universe 6 Saiyans were comparatively far more peaceful, which is likely responsible for their increased number of S-Cells.

Furthermore, the number of S-Cells affects the ease of the Saiyan's ability to transform into a Super Saiyan. A Saiyan with more S-Cells will need little emotional stress, if any at all, to push past the breaking point and transform. Vegeta, a violent Saiyan warrior with presumably a low number of S-Cells at the time, had to undergo great measures and extreme training to transform. Comparatively, Cabba, a peaceful Saiyan warrior with more S-Cells, only needed little emotional stress (Vegeta threatening to destroy Planet Sadala) to awaken his Super Saiyan form. Additionally, Trunks and Goten, who were born during peaceful times, likely had a higher number of S-Cells compared to their fathers, which would explain their ease in transforming early in their lives. This difference also appears to be responsible for a misconception in Universe 7 that only a Saiyan of pure heart could become a Super Saiyan, which Frieza mocked Vegeta for after witnessing Goku's transformation on Namek.

S-Cells may have some relation to a Saiyan's upper back area, directly below their neck, as by concentrating their power into this singular point within their body, they cause a "tingling sensation" and transform into a Super Saiyan, even without needing an emotional trigger in cases where the user has enough S-Cells.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Akira Toriyama / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: S-Cells dwell within a Saiyan's body and vary in amount depending on the composure of their spirit. By raising their battle power, a Saiyan can increase the number of S-Cells within their body.

entities.name: Sadala Army
entities.description:
The Sadala Army is the Saiyan military force in Universe 6. It is the mightiest army in that entire universe. The Sadala Defense Forces is a sub-group of the army made up of Saiyans in charge of protecting Planet Sadala from foreign invaders in Universe 6.

Renso is the retired captain of the Defense Forces and Cabba is part of the group, considered the ace of their Elite members. They are in service of the King Sadala. The army avoids Caulifla and her territory, as they are unable to defeat her and her henchmen, though in the manga her gang is shown to be a group of noble thieves, after robbing shipment of food & jewelry meant for King Sadala, the gang members are shown giving the food to poor Saiyan children (it is unclear if the Sadala Army is aware of this fact, as it could give them another reason to avoid conflict with Caulifla's Gang).

When Team Universe 6 lost in the Tournament of Power, the Sadala Army were erased with the rest of Universe 6. They were later revived when the erased universes were restored.

entities.name: Saiya Power
entities.description:
Though relatively unexplained, Saiya Power seems to refer to a Saiyan's natural energy, which appears to be red in color. In Dragon Ball Fusions, it is known as Red Energy and is one of five types of energy (Red Energy for Saiyans), separating it from energy types of other races. Traits of red-colored Saiya Power can be seen during Saiyan Ki Transfer, such as during Goku's Super Full Power Saiyan 4 and Xeno Goku and Xeno Vegeta's Super Full Power Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker transformations, respectively (both of which display a red radiation of energy).

Despite being a Tuffle, Baby was actually the first to demonstrate growth from Saiya Power in Dragon Ball GT, stealing it from the likes of Goten in order to become stronger. This eventually allowed him to reach much higher levels of power than his youthful form could manage.

Goku later acquired Saiya Power from Goten, Trunks, Pan, and Gohan in order to fully power his Super Saiyan 4 form to completely overwhelm Golden Great Ape Baby. During the Shadow Dragon Saga, he once again assumed Super Full Power Saiyan 4 by gaining Goten, Trunks, and Gohan's Saiya Power in order to fight Syn Shenron.

In Super Dragon Ball Heroes, Xeno Goku and Xeno Vegeta are able to achieve Super Full Power Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker with Saiya Power received from Xeno Pan, Super Saiyan God Xeno Trunks, Goku and Vegeta (who were in base form in the manga and Super Saiyan Blue in both game and anime scenarios). This new level of power allowed the Time Patrollers to eradicate Black Janemba completely.

entities.name: Saiyan
entities.description:
The Saiyans play a central role in the series once it is revealed that the protagonist, Goku, is actually a Saiyan sent to conquer Earth.

The name is a pun on yajin (野人) which means "wildman", and an anagram of yasai (野菜) which means "vegetable". The suffix -jin means "person". "Saiyan" is the English transliteration of the Roman letter term Saiya-jin. In the Japanese language, Saiya-jin (サイヤ) is pronounced "Sigh-ya-jeen" while in Funimation's English dubs, "Saiyan" is pronounced "Sey-uhn".

All full-blooded Saiyans (such as Raditz, Kakarot, Vegeta, Nappa, Paragus, Broly, or Bardock) have names that are puns on the names of various vegetables.

The homeworld of the Saiyans is Planet Sadala. The planet has a natural gravity that is ten times that of Earth, which helps give Saiyans a greater natural strength than most races. In Universe 7, the Saiyans lived here but their planet was destroyed by internal discord; in Universe 6, the planet still exists. In Universe 7, Planet Plant is conquered by the Saiyans after the defeat of the Tuffles, and they renamed it "Planet Vegeta" after their most powerful warrior and ruler, King Vegeta.

entities.name: Saiyan Army
entities.description:
The Saiyan Armed Forces or |Bejīta Gun}} (named the Saiyan Army only in the Funimation dub and Vegeta Forces in the English sub of Broly) is the Saiyan military force led by the king of Planet Vegeta, King Vegeta. Although King Vegeta was not its ultimate ruler as, during this time, the Saiyan Army appeared to be a branch within the Frieza Force. Frieza eventually destroyed Planet Vegeta, along with nearly the entire Saiyan race.

The army is first mentioned by Nappa when he states that he was its highest ranking and most powerful General.

The Saiyans took part in only one known conflict before the Saiyans were annexed by Frieza in roughly Age 731: the Saiyan-Tuffle war, in which they were victorious. After a ten-year long struggle, the Saiyans completely annihilated the Tuffles after a full moon arose, allowing their transformation into Great Apes. With the Tuffle race vanquished, the Saiyans completely colonized the planet, which - in the anime - they renamed Planet Vegeta after their commanding hero and King.

In Dragon Ball Super: Broly, it is revealed that the Saiyan Army originally served under King Cold before he retired and handed control of his empire to Frieza. Frieza was quick to demonstrate his power and cruelty when he detected hidden Saiyan snipers during a Scouter demonstration which had been brought to replace the Saiyans' Scout-Scopes. Frieza swiftly executed the snipers demonstrating both the Scouters effectiveness and giving the Saiyans a horrifying display of his incredible might. After the annexation by King Cold in Age 731, the Saiyans were apparently automatically conscripted into his Cold Force, and seemingly all Saiyans physically and mentally capable were automatically drafted in the Saiyan Army, though some low-class warriors like Gine where allowed to retire if they found army life unsuitable.

entities.name: Saiyan beyond God
entities.description:
This state first appears in Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection ‘F’, a pamphlet for the movie explained its nature.

The Saiyan beyond God state displays no real differences from the user's base form. As such, the user may only appear with the standard white aura their base form normally displays.

The Saiyan beyond God state appears to be a result of the Super Saiyan God's Crimson Radiance being retained in base form and further trained to be harnessed by the user naturally. Thus, Goku first unintentionally became a Saiyan beyond God in Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods, and then deliberately trained to master the new state in Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection ‘F’, which in turn caused the God's Crimson Radiance to evolve his Super Saiyan form into Super Saiyan Blue. Thus, Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan appears to be the Super Saiyan counterpart to Saiyan beyond God, as a Saiyan beyond God attempting to transform into a Super Saiyan will enter this state instead.

In the anime, while training inside Whis’s Staff, it is noted by Vegeta that to retain this state, the Saiyan must raise their energy while also controlling it so it does not leak out - it is noted by Goku that initially it is very demanding to keep all the energy inside, with Vegeta realizing that this is the secret to divine energy, calling it intense, and thus, like the Super Saiyan Blue form, this state requires absolute ki control to maintain it. In the Dragon Ball Super anime, the Saiyan beyond God state does not possess godly ki, but it raises the user's energy to the same power level of Super Saiyan God and allows the user to sense godly ki.

entities.name: Saiyan Power
entities.description:
This power allows a Saiyan to recover from harm in relatively short periods of time. During which, the Saiyan will imprint on the injuries and/or experiences and instantly learn from it. As it does, their minds and body adapt to the said struggles, allowing their instinctual methods and natural resistance to noticeably improve, which also increases their physical might and general efficiency as they recover, thereby lessening the chances of the problem happening again. The more severe the damage they recover from, the more significant the improvements will be, effectively making prolonged battles more favorable to them. Saiyan Power seems to increase noticeably after each use.

It is shown that accessing godly ki can greatly enhance the usage of Saiyan Power. It allows one to heal at an accelerated rate of mere seconds and likewise prove a noticeably more potent increase in power and efficiency. Even mere moments of pain or struggle will cause a quick and noticeable boost. When fully transformed into a divine form, the Saiyan is shown able to survive most otherwise-fatal injuries and regenerate from the damage. In Super Dragon Ball Heroes, the Warrior in Black theorizes that the incorporation of Zamasu's divine soul into Goku's body as the Crimson-Masked Saiyan allowed him to push the limits of his body and thus Saiyan Power even further.

As noted by Vegeta, a Saiyan cannot increase their power from self-inflicted wounds. This can be disputed by Goku's power increase after healing from his extreme gravity training, though Goku's boost could have come from a blast he was not actively controlling. Cell was also able to gain a noticeable power-up post-self-destruction, though his Saiyan attributes could have been improved through combination with his Namekian cells, granting him regeneration well-beyond that of a normal Namekian. The regenerative boost could have also come from the damage received from Super Saiyan 2 Gohan, who had kicked Cell so hard that he spat out Android 18 and reverted to his Semi-Perfect Form, creating a Saiyan Power boost so strong that it returned him to his Perfect Form as well as an ascension to Super Saiyan 2, creating "Super Perfect Cell".

The increase in power appears to be inconsistent. For instance, Vegeta's power level only received a moderate increase after he healed from his fight with Goku on Earth, rising from 18,000 to 24,000. On the other hand, Goku's power level made a massive jump from his battle with the Ginyu Force to his fight with Frieza, skyrocketing from 90,000 to 3,000,000 in a single go. It should be noted his body (while inhabited by Captain Ginyu) likely got boosted from the beating it took from Vegeta.

entities.name: Saiyan-Tuffle war
entities.description:
The Saiyan-Tuffle war is the name given to the ten-year-long civil war waged by the Saiyans and the Tuffles over control of Planet Plant.

Most of the information regarding the conflict comes from the anime and databooks.

The Tuffles, a very peaceful, yet technologically advanced race shared their planet with a very primitive, barbaric race known as the Saiyans. In the Dragon Ball GT: Perfect File and the Super Exciting Guides, as well as different information revealed by Baby, King Kai and Vegeta, it is revealed that the Saiyans themselves actually originated on the original Saiyan homeworld. By unknown means, the Saiyans either acquired or built many spaceships which brought them to the Tuffle home world.

It is explained by King Kai, and later by Baby, that the Tuffles had used their technological skills to construct and live in great cities. However, King Kai states that the Saiyans on the other hand, lived in small primitive villages in the outskirts and badlands of Plant. He also explains that although they shared the same planet, the two races rarely confronted each other and stayed relatively peaceful for many years. However, after a while, the Saiyans began to grow tired of living in filthy primitive villages (as well as allegedly being treated like slaves, from what Vegeta mentioned), and so it was devised that they would start a great war for the planet against the Tuffles.

entities.description:
Scarface is a Saiyan soldier who is short, bald with navy blue hair around his head like Borgos, two scratches on his face like Yamcha and long and sharp canine teeth.

He works alongside his partner Shorty, tormenting anything other than their own kind.

Scarface is a Saiyan from Planet Vegeta. Assuming that he did not die beforehand, he presumably died during Frieza's Genocide of the Saiyans. One of his taunts to the Z Fighters implies that he may have fought alongside his grandmother in the past.

While training for their battle against the forthcoming Saiyans (Vegeta and Nappa), Tien Shinhan, Yamcha, Krillin, and Chiaotzu use the Pendulum Room at The Lookout to travel backwards in time (by 100 years according to the English dub). The group materializes in a ravaged city on Planet Vegeta, littered with the corpses of Saiyans. It is here that they encounter Shorty and Scarface.

Sealas (Fused) heavily resembles its fusees' various traits. He possesses Ahms' yellow eyes, black skin and a pale-blue glowing core on his chest, along with Sealas' white hair and physical build. he also wears a red-colored ripped long backside cloth, and he also wields a blue glowing spear that has Ahms' features present on it.

Sealas (Fused) retains Sealas' personality due to Ahms' lack of a will of it's own.

Now that he has the power required to fulfill his goal, he is ready to carry out his plan to burn the Scroll of Eternity which will allow him to rewrite history as he sees fit thus can finally fulfill his utopian ideal of creating a "just" Multiverse as he views the current one as "unjust". Though he considers the Time Patrol and Dragon Ball Heroes' decision to challenge him as defying all logic, he welcomes it noting that he could not ask for better practice, confident they are powerless before his newfound power which he wishes to test against their combined might that had bested him and Ahms previously and forced Sealas' to enact the final phase of his plan ahead of schedule.

Like Sealas and Ahms, he shows no qualms about hurting/killing young children if it means achieving his goal as he plans on erasing the current history anyways thus, he has an "ends justifies the means" mentality.

Shadow Goku is a replica of Goku (from the Dragon Ball GT era) created by Black Smoke Shenron as his primary method of fighting.

Shadow Goku is a shadowy puppet shaped in Goku's likeness, though with a completely dark form. In Dragon Ball Heroes: Victory Mission, he has blank eyes.

When confronted by the Dragon Ball Heroes, Black Smoke Shenron creates Shadow Goku in order to combat them.

Shadow Goku made his debut in Dragon Ball Heroes, where he appears as a non-playable boss from Jaaku Mission 1. He appears during the boss fight with Black Smoke Shenron in the Shadow Dragon Saga, where he fights in the dragon's stead and is the target for attack.

entities.name: Shallet
entities.description:
Shallet, being the fusion of the twin brothers; Shallot and Giblet, looks remarkably similar to his fusees, having the same build and muscle mass along with Shallot's tail and Giblet's facial scar. Shallet combines the hairstyles of Shallot and Giblet, to have two large bangs rather than one. His outfit is composed of the standard Metamoran outfit of a black cropped vest with puffy yellow padding around the neck and arm holes, white baggy pants, a teal sash tied in a knot at his right hip, long black wristbands, teal leg wraps, and black shoes.

Being a fusion, Shallet's personalities are taken from several different traits from each fusee as well as unique traits of his own as a merged individual.

From his battle against Future Zamasu and Goku Black, Shallet is shown to be cool-headed like Giblet but bears a certain amount of pride or arrogance in his newfound power like how Shallot would act. During the fight, he boldly proclaims that the two gods will never reach his level of power, not in a million years.

After given the chance to fuse due to Piccolo decimating the two clones of Goku Black who were beating the twins by his Special Beam Cannon, Shallot and Giblet perform the Fusion Dance and emerged immediately as a Super Saiyan God. He introduces himself to Future Zamasu and Goku Black as the Fusion born between twins who possesses the power of Gods, Shallet. Both of the rogue Gods were in utter disbelief of Shallet's surging power, so much so that it places Goku Black in denial, refusing to believe a mortal even fused can surpass his godly might. However, Shallet grew tired of their talk and asks them to fight but tells them not here. As he quickly sent the two to the Stratosphere, with Piccolo and the others unable to see Shallet land the blow. Shallet himself becomes aware of this and claims to not know his own strength, then follows Future Zamasu and Goku Black in the Stratosphere.

entities.name: Shallot
entities.description:
Shallot is a Saiyan who has a medium build, and hair resembling a much shorter version of Raditz's with a front fringe straying to the right. He wears blue colored leather Sadala Saiyan armor, being from the time before Frieza Force armor became standard. His armor plates, greaves, and armbands are blue, and the undershirt and shorts are black. He has silver-tipped blue boots, and a black tail which he lets swing freely, rather than securing it around his waist as most modern adult Saiyans do.

Shallot has good fighting potential and is quite short tempered and aggressive like usual Saiyans. Although quick to go off at people, Shallot has his own morals and does not like being commanded. Like Goku and Vegeta, he has a strong appetite and similar to Beerus and Whis, he develops a fondness for Earth cuisine to the point he believes Dodoria has bad sense of taste after he claims Earth's food is terrible. He is noted to have a similar personality to Caulifla and the two get along. Shallot also seems to judge a warrior not by power but by how determined they are. Like most Saiyans, Shallot has little interest in romance and like the pure-hearted Goku, lacks perverted thoughts (as Master Roshi suggests Shallot is pure of heart) though unlike Goku seemingly fails to recognize this trait in others as he couldn't understand why Caulifla and Rozie were enraged by Master Roshi's lecherous behavior. It is unclear if this is due to his personality and/or another result of his lack of memory.

However, he is shown to be able to tell males and females apart just fine and rejects the teenage Bulma's playful attempt to flirt with him when she cheekily suggests that he secretly longs for her company after they had been apart for a while. Additionally, when she compliments him after he saves her and Jaco from some Saibamen shortly after they first met, Shallot was quick to point out that complimenting him won't get her anymore free security and only agreed to become her bodyguard after she convinced him that she could teach him more about Earth. Additionally, Shallot makes it clear that he plans to "bleed" them dry of their knowledge and dismisses Jaco's criticism that he shouldn't have said his intentions out loud. Shallot also has a tendency to use words relating to violence, regardless as to whether he is speaking metaphorically, such as the aforementioned "bleed them dry" phrase or literally when he threatened that his second confrontation with Raditz would be a "massacre".

However, despite his initial coldness, he can't stand to see innocents such as children harmed and rejected Raditz's offer to join him in taking down Piccolo and Gohan, as Shallot had no intention of beating up a little kid. However, he can be somewhat tactless and ends upsetting Gohan with an offhand remark. However, he learns from his mistakes and later even tells Piccolo after he recovers to be nice to Gohan.

Together with Moroko and Nion, Shito discusses the power of Broly and Vegeta IV with King Vegeta.

entities.name: Dragon Team
entities.description:
The , also known as the Dragon Ball Gang, is a group of Earth's mightiest warriors. Formed during Goku and Bulma's search for the Dragon Balls, they have since fought many battles in order to test their skills and reach other goals, and in turn have become the unofficial defenders of Earth.

The sub-team of fighters who are a part of the Dragon Team are referred to as the .

The team un-officially formed when Goku agreed to go with Bulma on her quest to find the Dragon Balls. They traveled past Mount Paozu and into Skull Valley where they met Turtle. Goku and Bulma returned the turtle back to the ocean where his owner, Master Roshi, gave Bulma his Dragon Ball and Goku the Flying Nimbus as a reward. After Oolong joined Goku and Bulma they met the desert bandit and Bulma's eventual boyfriend Yamcha and Puar in Diablo Desert, who would later become additional members of the team. At Fire Mountain, they met the Ox-King and Chi-Chi, who would become Goku's wife several years later. Later, while training with Master Roshi for the 21st World Martial Arts Tournament, Goku met his best friend Krillin, and also Launch.

While dealing with the Red Ribbon Army, Goku reunited Bulma, Krillin and his other friends in search of his Dragon Ball resulting in their confrontation with the Red Ribbon Army. While Master Roshi, Launch and Turtle take down another batch of Red Ribbon soldiers invading their island for the Dragon Ball kept at the Kame House. Goku would eventually take down the entire army single-handedly. Afterwards, the entire team (sans Oolong and Launch) gathered at Fortuneteller Baba's Palace in order to do battle with her warriors as a price for her telling them where the final Dragon Ball is, for Upa.

entities.description:
Android 1617 has the facial features of Android 17, and instead of 17's Scarf, wears a headband reminiscent of it, under hair that combines 17's bangs with Android 16's spiky tops. 1617 also dons Android 16's vest, and wears the signature Metamo-Ring that all EX-Fusions wear to maintain their fusion. He wears jeans that, unlike Android 17's, aren't ripped.

Android 1617 looks and sounds strong. Given his fusee both love and are protective of nature, 1617 likely shares these feelings.

Android 1617 appears to be a combination of the Android 16 and Android 17 from the Androids Saga. He would likely be stronger than Semi-Perfect Cell, and possibly put up a good fight against Perfect Cell. In Dragon Ball Fusions, it is stated in Android 1617's profile that the fusion of two Android creates unspeakable power however they are only an A-Rank fusion putting their power on par with Android 1920, but weaker than S-Rank fusions such as Android 1718 , Cell 17, and Perfect 16. He is also weaker than Perfect Cell who is also an S-Rank fighter.

entities.name: Transformation
entities.description:
There are several Saiyan transformation lines in the series, which are: the Great Ape line, the Super Saiyan line, and the Super Saiyan God line. Additionally, some forms can be mixed together to make new transformations.

There have also been several occurrences of other races utilizing Super Saiyan-like forms.

The Great Ape is one of the most common transformations seen used by pure Saiyans. This form is only accessible if the Saiyan has a tail. While in the form of a Great Ape, if the tail is cut off, the Saiyan returns to his/her normal state. This transformation is triggered by when Blutz Waves are transferred to the Saiyan. The most common supply of Blutz Waves is given from a Full Moon. If there is no moon available, a Saiyan may use a Power Ball. The Power Ball emits Blutz Waves used to activate the transformation. Once transformed, the Great Ape's power and strength are increased tenfold from the base form. If just started with this transformation, the Great Ape may go into a rampage. This form had been rendered obsolete ever since the remaining pure-blooded Saiyans transformed into Super Saiyans. A Great Ape who transforms into a Super Saiyan becomes a Golden Great Ape, which is the key to attaining the Super Saiyan 4 transformation.

A Super Saiyan is a legendary transformation of legend in the Saiyan race. Only a select few of the Saiyans have been able to achieve this rare form. In legend, a Super Saiyan is a warrior pure of heart and awakened by fury. The first Saiyan in centuries to achieve this form was Goku, after seeing Krillin's death at the hands of Frieza. In this transformation, the hair raises and turns a golden color, and the eye color turns blue green. A Super Saiyan's power level shoots up between ten to fifty times its normal amount, depending on the source.

entities.name: 100% Activation
entities.description:
100% Activation is an ability used by Frieza in his Final Form in order to utilize his 100% Full Power.

Frieza powers up with a yellow aura around his body to increase his power. Once the state is activated, a white and purple aura appears around his body.

Frieza power up to his 100% Full Power form while fighting Super Saiyan Goku, after using his "Destroy The Planet!" in order to cause Namek's core to begin detonating. Frieza later powers down from his 100% Full Power form to his 50% Power form to battle Gohan but reuses his 100% Power form again when Goku returns.

100% Activation was named in Dragon Ball Z: Supersonic Warriors 2, where Frieza uses his regular Final Form to reach his 100% power without enlarging his muscles. The power up increases Frieza's attack power. Category:Techniques Category:Supportive techniques

entities.name: 100% Full Power
entities.description:
100% Full Power is a transformation-like power up that can be assumed by certain members of the Frieza Race. As a form that requires tremendous amounts of energy to maintain, it is only used as a last resort but allows the user to draw out their maximum power and bulk out their muscles, in addition to drastically increasing their resilience and speed.

The 100% Full Power form resembles the user's true form but is taller and much bulkier in comparison.

Not every member of Frieza's race possesses the ability to go to 100% Full Power, with only Frieza and Frost being confirmed as users. It is very possible, however, that a mutant like Cooler has the potential to do it, seeing as his Fourth Transformation makes him among other things far more muscular than he was before.

Naho Ooishi in an interview for Resurrection ‘F’ stated that Frieza's power has always been in a different league from the rest of his family. Thus, it is possible that only a member of the race with an extremely powerful body can handle this level of power in their true form; like the mutant prodigy Frieza.

entities.name: 100% Death Ball
entities.description:
First, Frieza raises both of his hands up in the air and forms a pink energy sphere. Then, he rapidly charges it multiple times, making it bigger and more powerful. Finally, Frieza throws his hands forward and fires the attack at the opponent, inflicting a huge amount of damage.

Frieza uses this attack during his battle against Goku after knocking the Super Saiyan underwater. Fortunately, Super Saiyan Goku manages to catch the 100% Death Ball and punches it up toward the sky, sending it to another planet that explodes immediately. For a brief moment, Goku looks weakened after being able to counter Frieza's 100% Death Ball.

In the Budokai Tenkaichi series, it is named 100% Death Ball where it is the same color of the normal Death Ball and is Frieza's Ultimate Blast in his Full Power form. The attack is replaced by Last Emperor in Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3.

In Dokkan Battle, it is named Full Power Death Ball where it is Roar of Resentment Frieza (Full Power)'s Ultra Super Attack.

entities.name: Angel
entities.description:
The are life-forms of extremely high status within the hierarchy of the multiverse. Their role is to guide and teach Gods of Destruction to master their destructive capabilities while also serving them as their personal attendants. In the case of the Grand Minister, however, his duties are to serve and to advise Zeno. As deities, they possess godly ki. Whis has mentioned the Angel Realm and his home planet.

There are two known types of Angels: |Gaido Tenshi}} and Trainee Angels.

In the manga and anime, it was revealed that the Grand Minister is the father of all other known Angels, with Kusu being the oldest child.

Angels have no need for food, though they can eat and drink as a luxury. They also have no need for sleep, unlike Gods of Destruction and Supreme Kais.

entities.name: 100x Big Bang Kamehameha
entities.description:
Arching back, Gogeta brings his hands to his sides before moving them forward again, creating a massive Big Bang Attack before condensing a Kamehameha into the sphere and launching it forward as a massive energy wave, eclipsing even the normal Big Bang Kamehameha in size and power and utterly devastating the opponent.

In most games, it is capable of inflicting major damage to the stage of play. With a few exceptions to which map is being played, whenever Gogeta uses the 100x Big Bang Kamehameha, it completely changes the stage to Ruined Earth or Dying Namek.

In Budokai 3, the Budokai Tenkaichi series, Infinite World, and Budokai HD Collection, it is Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta's Ultimate Blast. In Sparking Zero, it is named Ultra Big Bang Kamehameha.

In Dragon Ball Heroes, it is named and is Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta (GT)'s Super Attack. It can also be used by Goku, Gohan, and Beat.

entities.name: Animorphaline
entities.description:
The Animorphaline drug was popular on Earth when Bulma was around ten years old, resulting in many Human-type Earthlings permanently becoming . In the Cell Saga Sub Story: "Animorphaline Accident", a few days before the Cell Games, while foraging for rare mushrooms that Korin needs to make some tea, Goku encounters two beastmen in the cave where the mushrooms grow. Believing Goku to be a Human-type Earthling, they assume he is there to mock them and Goku is forced to leave. Using Instant Transmission to pick up the Animal-type Earthling Oolong to help break the ice. The two beastmen assume Oolong is a Beastman until he explains he was born an Animal-type. The Beastmen reveal that they had taken an extra strength version of Animorphaline. Unfortunately for them the Animorphaline fad had since come to an end, and they were forced to live in the cave for fear of being mocked. Goku decides to find a way to help them return to normal.

Taking Oolong back to Capsule Corporation in order to speak with Bulma, Goku also encounters Android 16 who acts coldly towards Goku due to his programming. Goku asks if Bulma knows what Animorphaline is and she explains that it is a serum created by Magical Pharmaceuticals and explains how it was popular during her childhood, even noting that King Furry was originally a Human-type Earthling who took some and became a Beastman. She also notes how nobody really takes the stuff anymore and enquires why he asked. Goku explains about the two Beastmen who became stuck after taking an extra strength version of the drug, which Bulma had never heard of before. Bulma asks Android 16 if he has any knowledge of it, but he refuses to help Goku though she points out it is the Beastmen who need help, so Bulma asks Goku to step outside in the hopes 16 will tell her to help the Beastmen. Android 16 agrees to help after Goku leaves as he wishes to repay Bulma for repairing him.

entities.name: Arlia
entities.description:
The planet is mostly covered in ruins of old and crumbling buildings, aside from the palace, and the atmosphere was dark and unpleasant looking and has two moons in its sky. Aside from the residential Arlians, there are also giant caterpillar-like steeds.

While on his way to Earth with Nappa, Vegeta set the wake-up timer on his Attack Ball early so he could take over Arlia, with the intention of capturing the planet for the Frieza Force to sell. After a battle with King Moai and his guards, it was destroyed by Vegeta using a Galick Beam, after he and Nappa decided that the planet was in too poor of a condition to bring in any good profit for the Frieza Force.

During the destruction of the planet, it shows one moon being destroyed with the planet. However, when Vegeta and Nappa are on the planet, the sky holds two moons, it is possible that the second moon was simply too far away to be destroyed as well.

entities.description:
Goku fires a massive God Kamehameha whose power is multiplied ten-fold while in his Super Saiyan Blue Kaio-ken power-up with the 10x multiplier, inflicting colossal amounts of damage, while causing a huge explosion that damages its surroundings.

In the anime, Goku uses this technique toward the end of his battle with Hit, however the assassin manages to avoid it using his improved Time-Skip. It is seen in use as part of his Evolved Attack in order to break through the assassin's Time-Skip.

In Dragon Ball Heroes, it is Super Saiyan God SS Kaioken Goku's super move.

In Dokkan Battle, it is named 10x Kaioken God Kamehameha where it is the Super Attack for Next-Level Strike Super Saiyan God SS Goku and Final Super Power Super Saiyan God SS Goku (Kaioken).

entities.name: Aura of a God
entities.description:
The state is attained by one who has received training to become a God of Destruction.

As noted by Top, the Super Saiyan God state possesses the Aura of a God.

By activating his godly ki, Top's power increases to a whole other level from what it was before. This allowed him to fight on par with Super Saiyan God Goku and even defeat him in his Perfected Super Saiyan Blue form though, the latter was said to have dropped his guard (not used his full power in the Viz translation).

In the Tournament of Power, as Perfected Super Saiyan Blue Vegeta began overwhelming him, Top used this state's full power which he kept in reserve in order to regain equal footing.

entities.name: 10x Kamehameha
entities.description:
While the most prominent feature of the 10x Kamehameha compared to its counterparts is its crimson coloration, in its first appearance in the Baby Saga resembled that of a standard Super Kamehameha (lightish blue). It also possessed a delayed effect that inflicted further damage to an opponent it struck later in battle (though outside of this singular appearance it acts completely like a normal Kamehameha). The first time Super Saiyan 4 Goku attempted the 10x Kamehameha, he needed to charge two energy spheres and merge them together, but later on in the series, he charges the attack like any other Kamehameha.

As indicated by the name, the 10x Kamehameha has 10x the power of a Super Kamehameha. However, it does not always have to be used at this level of power, as Goku on one occasion unwillingly used a 10x Kamehameha that was not even 5x stronger than normal as a result of subconsciously being worried about Pan.

At the time of the Super 17 Saga, it was Goku's greatest technique.

Midway into his fight with Golden Great Ape Baby Vegeta, Super Saiyan 4 Goku rises into the air before uniting two energy spheres in his hands to perform the 10x Kamehameha for the first time. Despite its massive power, the attack only inflicts a little damage to Great Ape Baby. But shortly after, the delayed effect of the technique kicks in and the Tuffle parasite is temporarily paralyzed, sending him plummeting to the ground. This allows Goku to temporarily catch his own breath, but both fighters are exhausted from the exchange.

entities.name: Awakened Form
entities.description:
The is the form the race of the Heeters take on by retaining control of themselves once they have unleased their inner nature.

This form had no official name as of the interview with Toyotarou in August of 2022, he had come up with a name for it but had not yet discussed it with Akira Toriyama. The form was later referred to as the "Awakened Form" in the Dragon Ball Super Interval Special.

When a user of this form cannot fully control their unleashed inner nature, they can only use a portion of its power, needing to take on the Inner Nature Unleashed state in order to manifest it fully.

40 years before the Granolah the Survivor Saga, the young Gas utilized this form against Bardock but despite being at an advantage, unwillingly further transformed into the Inner Nature Unleashed state as a result of his frustration.

entities.name: Babari
entities.description:
It was previously a part of the Prison Planet under the name Green Area.

Babari is shown to be a lush green planet inhabited by the Babarians. In 1000 years, they are shown to form a tribe, discover fire, used trees to make clubs and have started using clothes. They even create musical instruments and develop some kind of rudimentary writing.

The planet was erased along with the rest of Universe 10 by Zeno and Future Zeno after Team Universe 10's defeat in the Tournament of Power. It was later restored when the erased universes were restored thus explaining how it could still exist in Age 1779 (Age 1780 in the anime), as Gowasu and Zamasu's visit to that period was done before the events of the Tournament of Power as the visit occurred during the "Future" Trunks Saga.

A version of the planet was stolen by Fu and made a part of the Prison Planet. Numerous battles occurred here. In the game Babari was destroyed along with the rest of the Prison Planet, while in the manga the planet was sent back to Universe 10 by Oolong's wish.

entities.name: Barrier of Light
entities.description:
Right after the fusion, Fused Zamasu combines both sources of his power and a halo of light appears behind his back. This is a powerful technique since it allows him to eliminate all attacks toward him as well as strike his opponents by firing multiple purple-colored lightning blasts. This technique also raises the power of Fused Zamasu immensely.

It eventually disappears after Zamasu's regeneration is revealed to be stunted, due to him being fused with the mortal Goku Black, in which he begins turning a gooey purple substance (presumably Zamasu's blood) on the right side of his face, which at this point the Barrier of Light was defeated by Super Saiyan Blue Kaio-ken Goku's God Kamehameha.

In Xenoverse 2, as part of the Super Pack 4 DLC, the Future Warrior can use Barrier of Light as part of Fused Zamasu's skills Blades of Judgement, Holy Wrath, Divine Wrath: Purification, and Absolute Lightning. However, it only appears during those techniques, and it disappears after those attacks are completed.

In Dragon Ball Heroes, the Barrier of Light appears as a separate form for Fused Zamasu named Haloed that was added in the third SDBH mission. A card of his Universal Conflict Saga variant with the halo was added in Universe Mission 11.
